item.text: The backend creates tables with provisioned throughput and decides whether to enable auto scaling after table initialization. I’ll add billing mode to configuration, return it from the table status check, and use the actual mode to decide whether auto scaling applies.
The implementation is in place. The package test is still running; I’m also checking that configuration rejects unsupported modes and that both creation paths set the AWS request fields correctly.

item.text:
Updated the DynamoDB backend to accept `billing_mode`, defaulting to `pay_per_request`. New on-demand tables are created without provisioned throughput, and auto scaling is ignored for on-demand tables. Provisioned tables retain configured throughput and auto scaling support.

Added configuration tests. `go test ./lib/backend/dynamo` and `git diff --check` pass.
